sources.title: GitHub - jandk/tinycast · GitHub
sources.snippet: A cast file is a stack of nodes. Each node: Has an identifier (the type), a unique 64-bit hash, and a bag of properties Can have children (forming a scene graph per root) tinycast maps that 1:1 to Java types under CastNodes: Root → scenes; contains Model, Animation, Instance, Metadata Model → optional Skeleton, plus Mesh, Hair, BlendShape, Material Skeleton → Bone, IkHandle, Constraint ...
